One compact hub with an HDMI port, two USB-A 3.0 ports and a USB-C data port, each running at 5Gbps. It also includes a USB-C PD input port for charging up to 100W and dual SD and TF card slots.

The HDMI port delivers exceptional clarity and smoothness at 4K@60Hz, making it ideal for high-definition presentations and entertainment. Only the HDMI port supports video projection; the USB-C port is for data transfer only.
The two USB-A 3.0 ports and the USB-C port all support a fast 5Gbps data rate, so large files move quickly.
Pass-through charging delivers up to 85W to your laptop, so you can work and charge through a single connection.
Anker USB-C Hub (7-in-1), a welcome guide and a 12-month warranty.
